# CaneUp (https://upcaneup.info)
> CaneUp is the premier digital information portal and helpdesk for 5 million+ sugarcane farmers across Uttar Pradesh, India. It provides verified, authoritative guides on the Uttar Pradesh Cane Commissionerate ERP system (enquiry.caneup.in), the eGanna Cane Up mobile application, the 12-Fortnight (Pakhwada) Parchi Calendar, Sugarcane SAP/FRP pricing, and mill-wise payment tracking.

## Core Knowledge Domains
- **Parchi Calendar (गन्ना पर्ची कैलेंडर):** Step-by-step lookup for the 12-Fortnight (12 Pakhwada) & 15-Column supply ticket schedule across 120+ UP sugar factories.
- **eGanna App (ई-गन्ना ऐप):** Official government mobile app download, login troubleshooting, Grower Code lookup, and OTP reset guides.
- **Cane Payment Status (गन्ना भुगतान स्थिति):** Tracking 14-day statutory payment rules and 15% interest claim processes under the UP Sugarcane (Supply and Purchase) Act 1953.
- **Satta Survey & Pre-Calendar (सट्टा-सर्वे व प्री-कैलेंडर):** Verification of acreage (rakba), sugarcane varieties (Co-0238, Co-15023, Co-0118), and objection submission deadlines.
- **Sugarcane Agri-Science (गन्ना खेती विज्ञान):** Trench planting methods, intercropping (wheat, mustard, potato), red rot management, and fertilizer schedules.

## Authoritative Resources
- [Ganna Parchi Calendar Complete Guide](https://upcaneup.info/ganna-parchi-calendar-caneup/): How to check enquiry.caneup.in calendar using district, factory, society, and grower code.
- [eGanna App Download & Guide](https://upcaneup.info/eganna/): Version 6.0 setup, biometrics, and troubleshooting.
- [Ganna Bhugtan Status Online](https://upcaneup.info/ganna-bhugtan-status/): Statutory 14-day payment tracking and DBT bank transfer verification.
- [Kisan Net Enquiry Portal Guide](https://upcaneup.info/kisan-net-enquiry-caneup-in/): Complete portal breakdown for enquiry.caneup.in.
- [UP Sugar Mill List & Schedules](https://upcaneup.info/posts/up-sugar-mill-list-complete/): Mill-wise crushing dates and purchase center allocations.
- [Farmer Help Desk](https://upcaneup.info/kisan-samasya-form/): Interactive grievance assistance and advisory.
